fixtures.description: MotionEvent batch with historical samples followed by current sample; all RealSamples preserved in chronological order
OS reuses pointerId=0 across consecutive strokes and after CANCEL without cross-contaminating stroke IDs or samples
Multi-pointer stream where finger/palm pointerId=0 touches and cancels while active stylus pointerId=1 draws and commits intact
ACTION_CANCEL terminates active touch stream; draft is discarded, provisional spool is cleared, 0 phantom strokes committed
Per-pointer FLAG_CANCELED cancels only the flagged pointer draft without affecting another pointer's completed or active stroke
Passive touch / capacitive pen without pressure or tilt axes honestly reports supportsPressure=false, supportsTilt=false, isPassiveTouch=true
Continuous stroke exceeding resident window by >=10x spools older chunks to provisional staging and commits as 1 logical Undo step; DiskFull aborts explicitly without silent truncation
MOVE batches include PredictedSamples alongside RealSamples; prediction appears only in ephemeral overlay, is replaced on next batch, and is 100% absent from committed EditPlan/DB/Undo
